upstream.base_commit_subject: fix(flex): support unsigned dtypes in int_argmax/int_argmin (#5630)
upstream.toolchain: rust 1.95.0 (crates/burn/Cargo.toml rust-version = "1.95"; CI RUST_PREVIOUS_VERSION 1.95.0; no rust-toolchain.toml)

feature.title: fix(store): harden and restructure the PyTorch reader
feature.author: antimora

gold_patch.fixtures: 9 binary fixtures (2 new .pt, 1 new .tar, 6 regenerated .tar); generated by create_protocol4.py and create_tar_format.py without torch

oracle.reference: PyTorch 2.13.0+cpu (pip, download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu) writes 28 accept files / 428 tensors at verifier-image build; tests/fixtures/gen_fixtures.py records names, dtypes, shapes, crc32 and bytesum of the row-major little-endian bytes in manifest.tsv; tests/harness/fixture_matrix.rs (integration test compiled against the submission) compares PytorchReader + bridge::to_data output and runs 32 reject cases one process each (ulimit -v 6 GiB, 180 s). Plus PR tests hidden (src/pytorch/tests, 71 reader + 37 store), pristine safetensors tests (52), pristine integration tests (20) and the pytorch-tests package (37 real nn.Module checkpoints via PytorchStore).

contamination.notes: Merged 2026-09-10, three days before task construction. The public PR body is paraphrased in instruction.md; the fixture matrix is generated in the verifier image and never published. Pre-existing 55 reader tests and all fixtures are visible in the base tree.

horizon.proxy: 8 source files, +2867/-2718 lines, one crate; 4 container formats x pickle protocols 0-5 x 13 dtypes x view/offset/stride semantics; 16 new upstream tests plus a 428-tensor differential matrix and 32 malformed inputs

evidence: https://github.com/tracel-ai/burn/issues/5412 (silent zero substitution on failed or truncated reads)
https://github.com/tracel-ai/burn/pull/5593 (maintainer PR body: protocols 0-5, archive-root resolution, real TAR layout, MAX_TENSOR_SIZE ceiling, opaque unknown objects, bounded allocations)
prior fixes in the same file: #5392 respect strides (Aug 27), #5411 TensorSnapshot -> burn_pack::Tensor (Aug 25), #5120 memo bomb (Jul 20)
